Vacancies for Faculty
Monday, 22 June 2015
7325 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts:
Professor in TB & Chest
Associate Professor in Surgery and Radiodiagnosis
Assistant Professor in Anesthesiology, Medicine,  General Surgery (3), Ophthalmology, Orthopaedics, Radiodiagnosis (2), Skin VD, Radiotherapy
Sr. Resident in Anesthesiology, Medicine, Orthopaedics, Radiodiagnosis, Surgery, Skin VD
The applicant should send their application to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) by
15th July 2015
. The appointments would be adhoc till the Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: As per the Medical Council of India norms.
Pay Scale
Professors/Assistant Professor:  As per rules (6th Pay Commission)
Senior Resident: Consolidated Salary of Rs. 43950/- per month.
For more details call at 07152 – 284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203)  or email at
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
